question: What is Diginex

beat.line: That turns point solutions into an end-to-end platform, from carbon accounting to human rights due diligence.
beat.headline: END-TO-END
beat.action: A paper ribbon threads through the four blocks and pulls them into a single continuous band.

sources: Following acquisitions of Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, and the transformative addition of Resulticks, Diginex is evolving from point solutions into a fully integrated end-to-end platform spanning carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain transparency, human rights due diligence, and now AI-driven customer data capabilities — designed to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.

By unifying carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain transparency and human rights due diligence into one platform, combined with Resulticks' AI-driven customer data capabilities, the company is positioning itself as a one-stop shop for sustainability and compliance workflows.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: pale cyan. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: the four-block bloc; a paper ribbon.
Opens on the four-block bloc, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: A paper ribbon threads through the four blocks and pulls them into a single continuous band.
Ends holding on the ribbon band.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "END-TO-END".

COPY LIST: "END-TO-END". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "That turns point solutions into an end-to-end platform, from carbon accounting to human rights due diligence.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a refined 2D motion design style. <Picture 1> serves as the first frame: a pale cyan flat block-color background featuring a central composition of four black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of Brutalist buildings, each with rough white torn-paper edges. A cream-colored paper chip is layered across the center with the bold black sans-serif text "4 ACQUISITIONS" printed on it. The lighting is a consistent upper-left source, casting small, subtle paper-layer shadows beneath the cutouts. At the very start of the shot, a flat matte paper ribbon in a contrasting cream color enters the frame quickly with a slight overshoot. The ribbon threads itself through the four building blocks, acting as a tether that pulls the disparate photographic cutouts together into a single, continuous horizontal band. Simultaneously, the "4 ACQUISITIONS" paper chip is replaced by a new cream paper chip with the bold black sans-serif text "END-TO-END" printed cleanly and legibly. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout. The movement is snappy and precise, concluding with a stable landing where the elements hold for a clear reading window. As the video ends, the building cutouts and the ribbon exhibit a very subtle, slow-looping floating motion. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range timbre speaking at a brisk but unhurried pace, says: <d>[English] That turns point solutions into an end-to-end platform, from carbon accounting to human rights due diligence.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the narrator's voice. Beneath the dialogue, tactile foley sounds occur in synchronization with the movement: sharp, light paper-slaps as the blocks snap together and the sticky, tactile sound of adhesive tape being pressed down.
